problem:
Let $R=[-2,1]\times [-4,-1]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $f(x,y)=2x-y+4.$
Further, let $P$ be a partition of $R,$ where

$$
\begin{aligned}{P}_{1}={{x}_{0},{x}_{1},…,{x}_{m}},\,{P}_{2}={{y}_{0},{y}_{1},…,{y}_{n}},\,P={P}_{1}\times {P}_{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Given that the upper Riemann sum of $f$ with respect to $P$ is given by

$$
U(f,P)={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}\boxed{}\,Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}
$$

where $Δ{x}_{i}={x}_{i}-{x}_{i-1}$ and $Δ{y}_{j}={y}_{j}-{y}_{j-1},$
what is the missing expression in the double summation above?

activity_context.topic_title: Upper Riemann Sums Over General Rectangular Partitions
